page.layout: One column of italic text, with the catchword "ad" at the lower right. No page number, no running head, no marginal notes.

p.i: An quintò ex textu aliquo scriptu-ræ breviter expositò, locum communem Theologicum, maximè de re aliquâ fidei controversa proponerem methodicè explicandum: ut de Scripturæ perfe-ctione, de satisfactione Christi, de authoritate Ecclesiæ, de Peccato Originali, de Justificatione fidei, de Merito operum, de Purgatorio, Transubstanti-atione, & id genus aliis?

An sexto locum aliquem communem Theologiæ practicæ sive Moralis pari modo explicarem; & casus dubios conscientiæ eò pertinentes ex certis agendi regulis et principiis illustrarem et dis-solverem: ut, de Votis, de Juramentis, de scandalo, de Rebus Adiaphoris, de li-bertate Christiana, de Obedientia et Sub-jectione, de civilibus Contractibus, de Divortiis, de Restitutionibus, aliisque ad

page.notes: The "s" long s is transcribed as plain s. Hyphenated line-end words keep their printed hyphen. The printed spacing in "deObedientia etSub-" is tight; I have read it as separate words. The accent on "controversâ" is faint and may be a circumflex or a plain a; I have written it without the accent. The first line of the second paragraph is indented, so it starts a new paragraph.
